facts.funnel_explanation: “Main chromosomes only” and “Skip known problem regions” remove nothing here, and the counts say why. Of the 15 translocation junctions in this file, none involves a contig other than the main chromosomes, and none touches a listed problem region. A caller run with an exclude list leaves such junctions out itself, so these steps only matter for files made without one.

facts.local_answer:
The strongest rearrangement in sample IMP01 based on read support is the balanced translocation t(20;21)(p13;q11.2), with junction coordinates chr20:200,000–200,001 and chr21:14,100,000–14,100,001. This rearrangement is supported by 44 read pairs and 16 split reads, totaling 49 distinct supporting reads.

The gene broken at this breakpoint on chromosome 20 (chr20) is ENSG00000224905, which falls within the intron 2 of its canonical transcript. This gene is OMIM-marked and is associated with disorders related to Down syndrome. On chromosome 21 (chr21), no specific genes are reported as being directly broken at this breakpoint.

Please review these findings for further analysis and validation.
